description: Enterprise techniques used by TRUSTTRAP, ATT&CK software S9064 (v1.0)
name: TRUSTTRAP (S9064)

techniques.comment: [TRUSTTRAP](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9064) has saved stolen credentials in a cleartext file.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[TRUSTTRAP](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9064) has captured victims’ credentials using fake login popup and stores captured data in a file.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[TRUSTTRAP](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9064) has a function to prompt the user with a fake popup that impersonates the Microsoft Outlook login window.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
